caption: The drawing depicts a single brown ceramic jug placed centrally on a beige background. The jug is cylindrical with a rounded shoulder leading up to a short, narrow neck with a slightly flared lip and a small rounded handle attached at the upper portion of the neck. The surface of the jug displays a subtle texture and shine, indicating a glazed finish. There is text on the upper portion of the jug reading "Whites Pottery Works, Fort Dodge, IA." At the bottom right of the image, the name "ED. BASHAW" is typed in uppercase letters. There are no other objects or ornamental details in the drawing; the composition is minimal with a focus on the jug.
title: Pottery Milk Jug
